abilities.description: The bulk of the Chariot keeps attackers away: the Rider section cannot be targeted by melee attacks (ranged attacks are unaffected). Once the Chariot is at 0 HP or below, this protection disappears.

abilities.name: Power Strike I
abilities.summary: Declared: +4 damage on one melee attack, Evasion -2 this turn.
abilities.description: Declared on an attack: that attack deals 4 extra damage, but the monster's Evasion checks suffer -2 for the rest of the turn. Same as the combat feat [Power Strike I].

modifiers.condition: after declaring Power Strike I this turn

abilities.name: Less Mobile
abilities.summary: Movement -10 for each Horse section at 0 HP or less.
abilities.description: Every time a Horse section drops to 0 HP or below, the Dullahan's movement speed is reduced by 10.

description: A huge headless black knight carrying its own head, riding a hellish chariot pulled by two skeletal horses; the Rider casts Truespeech and Divine Magic and cannot be reached in melee while the Chariot stands.

name: Ghast
description: A gaunt, jet-black construct built around a trapped soul and a shadow; it appears in groups and is sometimes called up by Barbarous using magic stones.

name: Cheap Stone

abilities.name: Crawl In
abilities.summary: Rolls under the feet of 1 adjacent character and knocks it prone (Danger Sense negates).
abilities.description: Rolls under the feet of 1 character within Range: Touch; unless the target succeeds on a Danger Sense check, it falls prone.

description: A palm-sized animated rock from Magic Civilization sites that stirs when mana users approach and rolls into them to trip them up.

name: Gargoyle

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.summary: Poses as a stone statue; unaware characters must pass Danger Sense vs 12 or be surprised.
abilities.description: It can pose as a stone statue. While it does, no Monster Knowledge check can be made against it, and a character who approaches without suspecting it must succeed on a Danger Sense check against a target number of 12 or be surprised. The disguise ends automatically once it starts to act. [Sense Magic] reveals it. (The book prints only the fixed target number 12; the stored check value is the equivalent standard value 5.)

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.summary: +1 Accuracy and Evasion in melee.
abilities.description: It gets +1 to Accuracy checks for melee attacks and +1 to Evasion checks against melee attacks.

modifiers.condition: vs melee attacks

description: A winged, clawed stone guardian from the Magic Civilization period that poses as a statue until careless intruders come close.

name: Door Imitator

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.summary: Poses as a door; unaware characters must pass Danger Sense vs 11 or be surprised.
abilities.description: It can pose as a door. While it does, no Monster Knowledge check can be made against it, and a character who approaches without suspecting it must succeed on a Danger Sense check against a target number of 11 or be surprised. The disguise ends automatically once it starts to act. [Sense Magic] reveals it. (The book prints only the fixed target number 11; the stored check value is the equivalent standard value 4.)

abilities.name: Throw
abilities.summary: Its melee hits knock the target prone.
abilities.description: Any character it hits in melee is knocked down and ends up prone.

description: A floating construct that passes for an ordinary door in dungeons and abandoned mansions, waiting motionless until someone comes close enough to open it, then slamming them to the floor.

name: Ghast Knight
description: A weapon-trained Ghast that retains some of its former martial skill and commands weaker Ghasts.

name: Homunculus

abilities.name: Truespeech Magic
abilities.summary: Casts Truespeech Magic spells up to level 3; Magic Power 6.
abilities.description: Can cast Truespeech Magic spells of level 3 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 6 (fixed 13). (Printed as a single line together with Spiritualism Magic at the same level and Magic Power.)

abilities.name: Spiritualism Magic
abilities.summary: Casts Spiritualism Magic spells up to level 3; Magic Power 6.
abilities.description: Can cast Spiritualism Magic spells of level 3 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 6 (fixed 13). (Printed as a single line together with Truespeech Magic at the same level and Magic Power.)

abilities.name: Magic Aptitude
abilities.summary: Knows [Targeting], [Magic Convergence], [Hawk Eye], [Metamagic/Targets] and [Wordbreak].
abilities.description: Combat feats available to it: [Targeting], [Magic Convergence], [Hawk Eye], [Metamagic/Targets], [Wordbreak].

description: An expressionless artificial human from the Ancient Magic Civilization that fights with a weapon and casts Truespeech and Spiritualism Magic.

name: Dorn

abilities.name: Mechanical Body
abilities.summary: Immune to criticals from edged weapons.
abilities.description: It cannot suffer critical hits from edged weapons.

description: A mass-produced, metal-clad security magitech about 1m tall that rolls on wheeled legs and pounds intruders with its hammer arm.

name: Zerlay

abilities.name: Mana Coating (1)
abilities.summary: Magic damage taken -1.
abilities.description: Every instance of magic damage it takes is reduced by 1.

abilities.name: Light Bullet
abilities.summary: 2d+3 energy magic damage to 1 character up to 20m away; needs Limited Move; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: Leans forward and shoots a bolt of light out of its back launcher at 1 character (Range/Area 2(20m)/Shot), dealing 2d+3 energy magic damage (Willpower halves). It can only be used when the Zerlay makes a Limited Move, and not on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Targeting
abilities.summary: No stray shots into a skirmish.
abilities.description: Its [Light Bullet] never goes astray when fired into a skirmish.

description: A slender humanoid magitech with a back-mounted launcher that fires light bullets every other turn; its armor is built to resist magic.

name: Burrdorn

abilities.name: Mechanical Body
abilities.summary: Immune to criticals from edged weapons.
abilities.description: It cannot suffer critical hits from edged weapons.

abilities.name: Hammer Throw & Pull Back
abilities.summary: Launches a hammer at 1 character up to 10m away for 2d+4 physical damage; that section gets Evasion -1.
abilities.description: A section fires its hammer at 1 character with Range/Area 1(10m)/Shot and reels it straight back, dealing 2d+4 physical damage unless evaded. The section that used it suffers -1 to Evasion checks until the start of its next turn.

modifiers.condition: the section that used Hammer Throw & Pull Back, until its next turn

description: A larger Dorn with a hammer on each side; each hammer can be launched at enemies up to 10m away and pulled back.

name: SZerlay

abilities.name: Mana Coating (1)
abilities.summary: Magic damage taken -1.
abilities.description: Every instance of magic damage it takes is reduced by 1.

abilities.name: Light Ray
abilities.summary: 2d+5 energy magic damage along a 20m line; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: Fires a huge beam of light with Range/Area 2(20m)/Line, dealing 2d+5 energy magic damage to the characters it hits (Willpower halves). Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Targeting & Hawk Eye
abilities.summary: Light Ray never strays into a skirmish and ignores shielding.
abilities.description: Its [Light Ray] never goes astray when fired into a skirmish, and it can be fired through the shielding created by hostile characters and skirmishes (as the combat feat [Hawk Eye]).

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
abilities.summary: The Launch Tube gets +4 Evasion against melee attacks while the Body is up.
abilities.description: Its height gets in the way of attackers: the Launch Tube section gets +4 to Evasion checks against melee attacks (no bonus against ranged attacks). The bonus is lost once the Body is reduced to 0 HP or below.

modifiers.condition: Launch Tube section only, vs melee attacks, while the Body has more than 0 HP

abilities.name: Loss of Mobility
abilities.summary: Cannot move once the Body is at 0 HP or less.
abilities.description: When the Body section drops to 0 HP or less, the SZerlay can no longer move.

description: A bigger four-legged Zerlay whose large back launcher fires a beam of light down a line, while its body keeps melee attackers away from the launcher.

name: Deela Harpy

abilities.name: Enchanting Song
abilities.summary: Song at 1 character within 20m: on a failed Willpower check it obeys simple sung commands.
abilities.description: Sings to 1 character within Range/Area 2(20m)/Target. If the target fails to resist, it follows the orders contained in the song. The orders must be simple and in a language the target understands, and it will not obey an order to harm itself. Psychic (weak) effect.

description: A mythical beast that is half bird, half beautiful woman; usually mild and willing to talk in Elven or Arcana, it can sing a foe into obeying simple commands.

name: Hellhound

abilities.name: Fire Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to fire effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any fire-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.summary: Fire breath on up to 3 adjacent characters: 2d+4 fire magic damage each; not in consecutive rounds.
abilities.description: Up to 3 targets within Range: Touch are engulfed in flame, each taking 2d+4 fire magic damage (Fortitude halves). Cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

description: A large jet-black hound that haunts ruins near Shallow Abysses, bites hard and breathes fire over several nearby foes; fire cannot hurt it.

name: Thunderbird

abilities.name: Lightning Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to lightning effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any lightning-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.summary: Lightning strikes a 6m radius around it: 2d+4 lightning magic damage; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: Calls down lightning around itself (Range: Self, Target: 1 area (6m radius)/20), dealing 2d+4 lightning magic damage to each target (Willpower halves). Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.summary: +1 Accuracy and Evasion in melee.
abilities.description: A Thunderbird gets +1 to Accuracy checks for melee attacks and +1 to Evasion checks against melee attacks. Lost while either Wing section is at 0 HP or less.

modifiers.condition: vs melee attacks

description: A huge bird cloaked in crackling lightning that pecks and buffets with its wings and blasts everything around it with thunderclaps.

name: Griffon

abilities.name: Continuous Attack
abilities.summary: Hitting in melee grants a second attack on the same target.
abilities.description: When a Griffon section hits a target with a melee attack, it may immediately attack that same target once more.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.summary: +1 Accuracy and Evasion in melee.
abilities.description: A Griffon gets +1 to Accuracy checks for melee attacks and +1 to Evasion checks against melee attacks. Lost while either Wing section is at 0 HP or less.

modifiers.condition: vs melee attacks

description: An eagle-headed, lion-bodied flier that nests in cliffs and hoards shiny treasure; every section attacks again after a hit.

name: Erbirea

abilities.name: Mana-inhibiting Poison
abilities.summary: A Claws hit lowers the target's Magic Power by 1 for 1 round (Fortitude negates).
abilities.description: A character struck by its Claws loses 1 point of Magic Power for 10 seconds (1 round) unless it resists with Fortitude. Poison-type effect.

description: A child-sized, shrimp-faced daemon from the Shallow Abysses whose claws carry a magic-dulling poison; weak alone, but it shows up in large numbers.

name: Aetherbeast
description: An otherworldly beast, usually shaped like an oversized wolf, that serves other daemons and savagely bites anyone threatening them.

name: Nazrak

abilities.name: Intimidating Gaze
abilities.summary: 1 character within 20m: -2 to all action checks for 1 round (Willpower negates).
abilities.description: Its terrifying stare (Range/Area 2(20m)/Target, 1 character) imposes a -2 penalty on every action check the victim makes during the next 10 seconds (1 round). Psychic-type effect.

abilities.name: Frenzied Gaze
abilities.summary: 1 character within 20m goes mad: +2 to action checks for 18 rounds but loses 5 HP at the end of each of its turns.
abilities.description: Its maddening stare (Range/Area 2(20m)/Target, 1 character) drives the victim temporarily insane: for 3 minutes (18 rounds) the target gets +2 to all action checks but loses 5 HP at the end of each of its turns, which can take it to 0 HP or below. The effect ends automatically if the target falls unconscious. Psychic-type effect.

abilities.name: Tail Sweep
abilities.summary: Declared: one Tentacle attack against up to 3 reachable characters; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: Declared on a Tentacle attack: it attacks up to 3 characters within reach with a single Accuracy roll; damage is rolled separately for each character hit. Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
abilities.summary: The Head gets +4 Evasion against melee attacks while both Tentacles are up.
abilities.description: Its size gets in the way of attackers: the Head section gets +4 to Evasion checks against melee attacks (no bonus against ranged attacks). The effect is lost if any Tentacle section is at 0 HP or less.

modifiers.condition: Head section only, vs melee attacks, while both Tentacles have more than 0 HP

description: A 5m octopus-like daemon with two tentacles and a single huge lidless eye whose gaze terrifies or maddens, while its tentacles sweep several foes at once.

name: Bandit Trooper

abilities.name: Sword's Grace/Change Fate
abilities.summary: Once per day, flip both dice of a check or damage roll to their opposite faces.
abilities.description: Once per day, after rolling 2d for a check or a damage roll, it may turn both dice to their opposite faces (1↔6, 2↔5, 3↔4) and use the new result.

description: A human thug with a mundane one-handed weapon and crude leather armor, usable for bandits, pirates, low-ranking soldiers or armed villagers.

name: Skilled Mercenary

abilities.name: Quick Slash
abilities.summary: Declared: +1 Accuracy on an attack; useless against metal armor.
abilities.description: Declared on an attack: that attack's Accuracy check gets +1. It has no effect against characters wearing metal armor.

modifiers.condition: target not wearing metal armor

abilities.name: Power Strike I
abilities.summary: Declared: +4 damage on one melee attack, Evasion -2 this turn.
abilities.description: Declared on an attack: that attack deals 4 extra damage, but the monster's Evasion checks suffer -2 for the rest of the turn. Same as the combat feat [Power Strike I].

modifiers.condition: after declaring Power Strike I this turn

abilities.name: Sword's Grace/Change Fate
abilities.summary: Once per day, flip both dice of a check or damage roll to their opposite faces.
abilities.description: Once per day, after rolling 2d for a check or a damage roll, it may turn both dice to their opposite faces (1↔6, 2↔5, 3↔4) and use the new result.

description: A seasoned human sellsword with sword, shield and leather armor who picks between quick, accurate cuts and heavy blows.

name: Familiar: Frog

abilities.summary: Immune to poison effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any poison-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Disease Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to disease effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any disease-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Psychic Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to psychic effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any psychic-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Can be Detected
abilities.summary: Detectable by [Sense Magic] and similar magic.
abilities.description: As a construct it shows up to detection magic like [Sense Magic] (CR I p.220) and [Mana Search] (CR I p.242).

abilities.name: Familiar Contract
abilities.summary: One familiar per master; vanishes if the contract ends or the master dies.
abilities.description: A master is bound to a single familiar at a time and can dissolve the bond as a Major Action; dissolving it or the master's death makes the familiar vanish instantly. While the master is unconscious, the familiar stays put and does nothing.

abilities.name: Familiars Knowledge = Sorcerers
abilities.summary: Sorcerers automatically identify familiars; familiars have no Weak Point.
abilities.description: Anyone with the Sorcerer class identifies a familiar automatically (their Monster Knowledge check always succeeds). No Weak Point exists for familiars.

abilities.name: No HP
abilities.summary: Damage to the familiar is taken from its master's HP instead.
abilities.description: It has no HP at all; whatever damage it would take is subtracted from its master's HP.

abilities.name: Shared MP
abilities.summary: The master can spend the familiar's MP while touching it.
abilities.description: While the two are touching, the master can spend the familiar's MP in place of their own. The familiar regains MP at the same pace as its master (by resting, etc.).

abilities.name: One Mind, One Character
abilities.summary: While touching its master, both count as one character and the familiar can't be targeted.
abilities.description: While the familiar touches its master, the two count as a single character, so area effects of magic, unique skills, traps and the like do not hit them twice. A familiar touching its master also cannot be targeted by melee or ranged attacks, magic or effects that target a character. Making a melee attack of its own removes this protection for 10 seconds (1 round).

abilities.name: Resistance Sharing
abilities.summary: Uses its master's Fortitude and Willpower.
abilities.description: Its Fortitude and Willpower checks are made with the master's own standard values, and the master is always aware when the familiar must resist something, however far apart they are.

abilities.name: Senses Sharing
abilities.summary: Shares sight and hearing (incl. Darkvision) with its master.
abilities.description: The familiar and its master share sight and hearing, including Darkvision: whatever one perceives, the other does too.

abilities.name: Fall Resistance
abilities.summary: Takes no falling damage.
abilities.description: The familiar never takes damage from falling, whatever the height.

abilities.name: No Loot
abilities.summary: Yields no loot.
abilities.description: Defeating a familiar never produces loot.

abilities.name: Will-less
abilities.summary: Has no will of its own.
abilities.description: It never acts on its own initiative; it has no will.

abilities.name: Frog's Body
abilities.summary: Can move underwater; a normal frog's mobility.
abilities.description: It can move underwater and otherwise moves like an ordinary frog.

description: A frog-shaped construct summoned with the Truespeech spell [Familiar] that can swim underwater and shares its senses and MP with its master.

name: Familiar: Spider

abilities.name: Familiars Knowledge = Sorcerers
abilities.summary: Sorcerers automatically identify familiars; familiars have no Weak Point.
abilities.description: Anyone with the Sorcerer class identifies a familiar automatically (their Monster Knowledge check always succeeds). No Weak Point exists for familiars.

abilities.name: No HP
abilities.summary: Damage to the familiar is taken from its master's HP instead.
abilities.description: It has no HP at all; whatever damage it would take is subtracted from its master's HP.

abilities.name: Shared MP
abilities.summary: The master can spend the familiar's MP while touching it.
abilities.description: While the two are touching, the master can spend the familiar's MP in place of their own. The familiar regains MP at the same pace as its master (by resting, etc.).

abilities.name: One Mind, One Character
abilities.summary: While touching its master, both count as one character and the familiar can't be targeted.
abilities.description: While the familiar touches its master, the two count as a single character, so area effects of magic, unique skills, traps and the like do not hit them twice. A familiar touching its master also cannot be targeted by melee or ranged attacks, magic or effects that target a character. Making a melee attack of its own removes this protection for 10 seconds (1 round).

abilities.name: Resistance Sharing
abilities.summary: Uses its master's Fortitude and Willpower.
abilities.description: Its Fortitude and Willpower checks are made with the master's own standard values, and the master is always aware when the familiar must resist something, however far apart they are.

abilities.name: Senses Sharing
abilities.summary: Shares sight and hearing (incl. Darkvision) with its master.
abilities.description: The familiar and its master share sight and hearing, including Darkvision: whatever one perceives, the other does too.

abilities.name: Fall Resistance
abilities.summary: Takes no falling damage.
abilities.description: The familiar never takes damage from falling, whatever the height.

abilities.name: No Loot
abilities.summary: Yields no loot.
abilities.description: Defeating a familiar never produces loot.

abilities.name: Will-less
abilities.summary: Has no will of its own.
abilities.description: It never acts on its own initiative; it has no will.

abilities.name: Snake's Body
abilities.summary: Slips through extremely narrow spaces; a normal snake's physical ability.
abilities.description: It fits through the tiniest of openings and has the physical abilities of an ordinary snake.

abilities.name: Toxic Tooth
abilities.summary: Its melee hits also deal 1 poison magic damage, while within touch range of its master.
abilities.description: When the familiar hits with a melee attack, the target automatically takes 1 poison magic damage as well. This only works while the familiar is within touch range of its master.

description: A snake-shaped construct summoned with the Truespeech spell [Familiar] that squeezes through tiny spaces and adds a little poison to its bites.
